cat > /tmp/sweep.py <<'PYEOF'

import importlib.util, os, sys, numpy as np
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("vf","/opt/weather-pipeline/repo/scripts/icon_front_very_far_snapshot.py")
vf=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(vf)
fields,lats,lons,run_dt,lead=vf.load_testcase("/tmp/case_oct1.npz")
centers=vf.find_pressure_centers(fields["pmsl"],fields.get("hsurf"),lats,lons)
fronts,stats=vf.compute_fronts(fields,lats,lons,centers=centers)
L=[]
for s in fronts:
    xy=s["xy"]; kx=111.32*np.cos(np.radians(xy[:,1].mean()))
    L.append(float(np.sum(np.hypot(np.diff(xy[:,0])*kx,np.diff(xy[:,1])*111.32))))
L=sorted(L,reverse=True)
print(os.environ.get("TAG","?"), "n=%d total=%.0f"%(len(L),sum(L)), "lens=",[round(x) for x in L])
PYEOF
ls -la /tmp/case_oct1.npz | cut -c1-80; tail -n 2 /tmp/icon_front_v4.log | cut -c1-160; (for c in 'cur 55 300' 'h80 80 300' 'h110 110 300' 'off 999 300' 'h80_min200 80 200'; do set -- $c; TAG=$1 ICON_FRONT_HOOK_MAX_TURN_DEG=$2 ICON_FRONT_MIN_KM=$3 python3 /tmp/sweep.py 2>&1 | tail -n 3; done > /tmp/sweep.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 1; echo started
